summaryZh: Maltez 实验室研究致病、肿瘤发生和免疫功能障碍中的免疫问题，关注影响免疫反应的细胞群落。团队使用高通量多重显微成像及反复染色和漂白的免疫荧光方法。
researchQuestions: 哪些细胞相互作用决定肿瘤对免疫治疗的响应？
methods: 迭代染色与漂白免疫荧光

evidence.quote: Leveraging an imaging arsenal to understand immunity Our Research Our Research The goal of the Maltez lab is to interrogate fundamental immunological questions in pathogenesis, tumorigenesis, and immune dysfunction. Our team utilizes highly multiplexed microscopy approaches to explore the distinctive cellular communities shaping immune responsiveness. We seek out and thrive in collaborative team science. We are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of immunological research and translating our findings into potential clinical applications. Read More Our methodologies Single cell protein profiling: high resolution multiplex microscopy This immunofluorescence technique enables us to deeply profile a tissue environment via an iterative staining and bleaching cycle. We can gain insight into the cellular composition, phenotypic state, and proximal neighbors in the tumor microenvironment. Read About the Origins of IBEX

She has now returned to her home state as part of the UCSD FIRST Faculty program to head her own laboratory focused on decoding the cellular interactions that dictate tumor responsiveness to immunotherapy.
